grep_search.description: Exact text pattern or regex search across files
grep_search.use_when: Finding specific strings or patterns in code files

codebase_search.description: Semantic search across the entire codebase
codebase_search.use_when: Finding code definitions, symbols, or semantic matches

read_file.description: Read and display the contents of a specific file
read_file.use_when: User wants to see the contents of a known file

list_dir.description: List files and directories in a path
list_dir.use_when: User wants to see what files or directories exist

run_terminal_cmd.description: Execute a terminal or shell command
run_terminal_cmd.use_when: User wants to run a command, script, build, or test

edit_file.description: Create, edit, or modify a file
edit_file.use_when: User wants to create or modify code or files

web_search.description: Search the web for documentation or external information
web_search.use_when: User wants information from external web sources
